name: photoreal-hero-verify
description: PHOTOREAL-HERO: Realistic mode draws hero GLBs in place of primitives — walk (living + dining), orbit, room editor, plus a flag-OFF A/B at the same walk pose. Re-pins deviceClass before each shot because the headless ladder demotes. Run with SHOT_GPU=1.

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: pose-living
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(10.9, 5.6); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.12) })()

steps.name: probe-1
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const glbs = []; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.name === 'hero-root') glbs.push(1) }); console.log('[probe] living', JSON.stringify({ dpr: window.__three.gl.getPixelRatio(), deviceClass: s.deviceClass, tier: s.qualityTier, heroRoots: glbs.length, cam: window.__three.camera.position.toArray().map(n=>+n.toFixed(2)) })) })()

steps.name: probe-2
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const glbs = []; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.name === 'hero-root') glbs.push(1) }); console.log('[probe] living-off', JSON.stringify({ dpr: window.__three.gl.getPixelRatio(), deviceClass: s.deviceClass, heroRoots: glbs.length })) })()

steps.name: pose-dining
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(9.6, 4.9); l.setYaw(Math.atan2(-1.6, -1.1)); l.setPitch(-0.2) })()

steps.name: probe-3
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); console.log('[probe] dining', JSON.stringify({ dpr: window.__three.gl.getPixelRatio(), deviceClass: s.deviceClass })) })()

steps.name: repin-4
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setDprHalved?.(false) })()

steps.name: repin-5
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setDprHalved?.(false) })()

steps.name: probe-5
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const glbs = []; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.name === 'hero-root') glbs.push(1) }); console.log('[probe] editor', JSON.stringify({ dpr: window.__three.gl.getPixelRatio(), deviceClass: s.deviceClass, heroRoots: glbs.length })) })()
